units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“我何必如此历尽无遗地细看呢？”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "Why must I look so closely at every last detail?"

units.source_text: 然而样子太古怪了，他反而要看。

en.t: Yet her appearance was so strange that it only made him want to look all the more.

units.source_text: 只有头的形状和挂下的头发很美丽，比较起以美发闻名的人来，并不逊色。

en.t: Only the shape of her head and the hair that hung down from it were beautiful, and they were not inferior to those of women famed for lovely hair.

units.source_text: 那头发挂到褂子的裾边，还有一尺许铺在席地上。

en.t: That hair fell to the hem of her robe, with about another foot spread out over the matting.

units.source_text: 现在再来描写她所穿的衣服，似乎太刻毒了；

en.t: To go on now and describe the clothes she was wearing seems rather too cruel;

units.source_text: 然而古代的小说中，总是首先描写人的服装，这里也不妨模仿一下：

en.t: however, in old tales a person's clothing is always described first, so there is no harm in imitating that practice here:

units.source_text: 这位小姐身穿一件淡红夹衫，但颜色已经褪得发白了。

en.t: The young lady wore a pale red lined robe, but its color had already faded until it looked whitish.

units.source_text: 上面罩一件紫色褂子，已旧得近于黑色。

en.t: Over it she had put on a purple outer robe, so old that it was nearly black.

units.source_text: 外面再披一件黑貂皮袄，衣香扑鼻，倒很可喜。

en.t: On the outside she had draped a black sable fur coat, and the fragrance of her clothing filled the air, which was actually rather pleasing.

units.source_text: 这原是古风的上品服装。

en.t: This was originally a fine garment in the old style.

units.source_text: 然而作为青年女子的装束，到底不大相称，非常触目，使人觉得稀罕。

en.t: Yet as clothing for a young woman, it was after all not very suitable; it stood out sharply and made one feel it was quite unusual.

units.source_text: 不过如果不披这件皮袄，一定冷不可当。

en.t: Still, without that fur coat, she surely could not have endured the cold.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看看她那瑟缩的脸色，觉得十分可怜。

en.t: Prince Genji looked at her pinched, shivering face and felt deeply sorry for her.
